reference.code: pub fn coalesce_ranges(v:&[(i64,i64)])->Option<Vec<(i64,i64)>>{if v.iter().any(|(a,b)|a>=b){return None}let mut a=v.to_vec();a.sort();let mut o:Vec<(i64,i64)>=Vec::new();for r in a{if o.last().map_or(true,|x|r.0>x.1){o.push(r)}else{let z=o.last_mut().unwrap();z.1=z.1.max(r.1)}}Some(o)}
